featuresTitle: What the new version can do

features.title: A living galaxy
features.text: Graduates drift through our space of craft and memories!

features.title: Several photographs instead of one
features.text: A form can hold more than one photograph. They change right in flight, in chronological order — from a small child to a grown-up.

features.title: Not just an avatar — a gallery as well
features.text: Besides the photographs that change in flight, a page can hold a gallery: performances, trips, backstage, life after school. As many frames as you like, and each one opens full screen. A few galleries are there already — tap the picture beside this one to look.

features.title: Teachers now have their own pages
features.text: Tap the head of the course or a teacher inside a graduate's card and the teacher's page opens — with a surprise on the right-hand side!

features.title: On the future adults page, the order of teachers depends on your forms
features.text: The list on the teachers page is ordered by the number of students: the more graduates mention a teacher in their form, the higher that teacher appears — and subject teachers count, not only heads of course. So it matters to remember and list yours.

features.title: Don't wait for everyone to respond
features.text: Fill in a form for a coursemate or a friend — you share the performances and the teachers, so you already know most of it. Every such form is one more page of the school history brought back.

features.title: A group can have its own page
features.text: With repertoire by year and recordings, shared photographs, the graduates of the group, its course master and teachers. These pages still need correcting, so look at your own group and write to me with the fixes — I will be waiting.

features.title: Every production now has its own page
features.text: It shows who performed and in which role, the masters, the recording, and whose repertoire the production belongs to. The cast and directors are assembled from your forms as well as AI analysis of lists: so there are many errors that we will fix together! If you spot a mistake, write to me.

features.title: Festival trips have their own pages too
features.text: Each one lists who travelled, which productions were taken along, the teachers of the trip and the shared photographs. The lists of participants were restored without AI, simply by trying to recognize faces in old photos, so mistakes are inevitable: if you were on a trip and are missing, write to me and I will add you.

features.title: The performing arts schools our graduates went on to
features.text: A list of its own, and every school has a page: who of ours enrolled there, in which year, on which programme and with which head of course. It is assembled from your forms and from the school’s own list of graduates, so gaps are inevitable — if you enrolled somewhere and are missing, write to me and I will add you.

features.title: The theatres where our graduates work
features.text: The same kind of list: theatre, city, country — and our people in it. It grows only from your forms, which is why it is still short: if you work at a theatre that is missing here, write to me.

features.title: New fields in the form
features.text: Teachers as a section of their own, next to the head of the course. Social links are no longer limited to Instagram and Facebook — YouTube works too. And a video card.

note: You can fill in or extend your form at any time. If something is missing or wrong, write to us and we will fix it.
askHint: Hi!) Questions, corrections, a group page — write to me
